title: Handlebar Dash
tagline: A round digital dash on its own handlebar clamp, replacing the stock instruments.
summary: A 2.8" round colour display in a classic round gauge, with the tell-tales (turn signals, high beam, neutral, ABS, engine, fuel, battery) lit in its own face. It reads the bike's own signals (speed, fuel, gear, indicators, warning lights) and adds GPS speed and trip, clock, battery voltage, air temperature, lean angle and g-force. A standard OBD-II port and three expansion slots let it grow. First bike: the J-platform 350 with the J1D3 harness (the Meteor 350).
status: Phase 1 (learning the bike's CAN bus) is ready to build, and the display head is modelled (v1, checked in CAD, not printed yet): a round gauge, 121 mm across, your logo above the screen and the 8 tell-tales down its sides, on the Meteor 350's 22.2 mm handlebar, Harley-style. The interface box comes next.

see_sub: A classic round gauge on the bar: the logo centred above the screen and the tell-tales in a curve down each side, in the gauge's own face, as on the Indian Scout's, KOSO's and Daytona's round gauges. 121 mm across, 39.6 mm deep.

gallery.caption: From the rider's seat: a round gauge on the bar, the logo above the screen, the lit tell-tales down its sides, a silver trim ring

The face: the logo at the top; turn left, high beam, neutral and ABS down the left side; turn right, battery, low fuel and engine down the right. Each icon is filled flush with clear resin over its own 5 mm RGB LED
Customise it: your own logo (a word, or an SVG file), which icons and how many, their size, or a plain face with the logo only
From the side: the face, its 45-degree shoulder and the cradle on the 22.2 mm bar
Taken apart: the trim ring, the shell, the carrier (the display screws to it), the back cover and the cradle with its 2 caps

head_shell.name: Shell (with tell-tales)
head_shell.what: The round gauge: the display's window, the logo engraved above it, the 8 tell-tale windows down its sides with their light chambers, the GPS antenna's hollow behind the logo
head_shell.material: Black PETG (ASA for the final part). Face down, no supports; 0.2 mm first layers for crisp icons

head_shell_plain.name: Shell (plain face)
head_shell_plain.what: The same gauge with the logo only (the tell-tales show on the screen)
head_shell_plain.material: Black PETG (ASA for the final part). Face down

trim_ring.name: Trim ring
trim_ring.what: The ring around the face's edge: glue it into the rebate
trim_ring.material: Silver (or any contrast colour) PETG or ASA. Flat

head_carrier.name: Carrier
head_carrier.what: The display screws to it (4 x M2 x 6 into its own standoffs); the GPS module and the CAN board go on its back

head_cover.name: Back cover
head_cover.what: Closes the back, presses the display onto the foam ring, carries the GX12 socket and 2 M4 inserts for the cradle

head_cover_stalk.name: Back cover (stalk)
head_cover_stalk.what: As the back cover, with the GoPro-style 3-prong joint instead of the cradle's inserts
head_cover_stalk.material: PETG, 4 perimeters (the joint). Plug edge down, joint up

lip_gasket.name: Foam ring
lip_gasket.what: 0.8 mm ring between the lip and the glass. Print in TPU, or cut it from 0.8 mm closed-cell foam

cradle.name: Cradle
cradle.what: The bridge that bolts to the back cover (2 x M4) and the upper halves of 2 bar clamps, either side of the bike's own handlebar clamp
cradle.material: PETG, 4 perimeters, 40 % infill. Bridge's back face down

cradle_cap.name: Cradle cap
cradle_cap.what: The lower half of each bar clamp, with traps for 2 M4 nuts

clamp_upper.name: Stalk clamp, upper
clamp_upper.what: Around the bar, with the 2 fingers of the joint (fits the cover's 3)

clamp_lower.name: Stalk clamp, lower
clamp_lower.what: The other half, with traps for 2 M4 nuts

head_assembled.name: Display head on the bar, assembled
head_assembled.what: The gauge in its cradle on the bar, with a simplified display (view only)

head_assembled_stalk.name: Display head on a stalk, assembled
head_assembled_stalk.what: The head on the GoPro-style joint (view only)

params.name: logo_text

params.name: icon_size
params.label: Icon size
params.help: Bigger than 5.5: widen the bezel too.

params.name: bezel

params.name: cradle_span

params.name: head_back

params.name: head_up
params.label: Cradle: the head's centre, above the bar's centre

params.label: Stalk: joint height above the bar's centre
